title: Invariant Testing — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Invariant Testing solution should meet the objective: Define at least one property that must hold across arbitrary transaction sequences and run an invariant test against a local test contract. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
